from pocket_coffea.cuts.masking import BaseMask
import awkward as ak

class DimuonMask(BaseMask):
    def __call__(self, events, params, **kwargs):
        muons = events.Muon
        pt_threshold = params["pt_threshold"]
        
        # Select muons above pT threshold
        muons_high_pt = muons[muons.pt > pt_threshold]
        
        # Require at least 2 muons
        n_muons = ak.count(muons_high_pt.pt, axis=1)
        mask_n_muons = n_muons >= 2
        
        # Check opposite charge for leading pair
        mu_lead = muons_high_pt[:, 0]
        mu_subl = muons_high_pt[:, 1]
        mask_opposite_charge = (mu_lead.charge * mu_subl.charge) < 0
        
        return mask_n_muons & mask_opposite_charge
